explanation: This fires only at D1, and only when the agent has been choosing a2 and has just had its second unrewarded trial in a row (the previous trial and the one before it both unrewarded). It hits about 10 early in the episode (roughly trials 8-22) and only about 4-8 later on or after a single loss; a third straight loss, any rewarded previous trial, a1 runs, and every GO and D2 step stay at 0.
